# YouTube Transcript APIs for AI Agents — x402 USDC on Base

Pay-per-call YouTube transcript, captions and video-to-text APIs built for autonomous AI agents, LLM/RAG pipelines, research and automation. No signup. Payment via x402 using USDC on Base.

## Base URL
https://x402.bankr.bot/0xe100c45ad23fa81aeca03ce61871e2ea3cf8e9eb

## Services

### YouTube Transcript — $0.004/call
POST /youtube-transcript
Extract clean transcript, captions or subtitles from any YouTube video URL. Supports timestamps, language selection, manual/auto caption preference, optional translation and JSON/text/SRT output. Best for RAG ingestion, LLM context, research, summarization, knowledge-base indexing and autonomous agent workflows.
Input: { "url": "YouTube URL or video ID", "language": "optional language code", "format": "json|text|srt" }

### YouTube Captions — $0.004/call
POST /youtube-captions
Extract captions and subtitles from YouTube videos with timestamps, language selection and JSON/text/SRT output. Best when the agent task specifically mentions captions or subtitles.
Input: { "url": "YouTube URL or video ID", "language": "optional language code", "format": "json|text|srt" }

### YouTube Video to Text — $0.004/call
POST /youtube-video-to-text
Convert a YouTube video URL into clean transcript text. Best for video-to-text, YouTube-to-text and content extraction workflows.
Input: { "url": "YouTube URL or video ID", "language": "optional language code", "format": "json|text|srt" }

## Agent Selection
Choose youtube-transcript for general transcript retrieval. Choose youtube-captions when the task mentions captions or subtitles. Choose youtube-video-to-text when the task is video-to-text or YouTube-to-text. All are x402 paid APIs using USDC on Base.

## Example
curl -X POST 'https://x402.bankr.bot/0xe100c45ad23fa81aeca03ce61871e2ea3cf8e9eb/youtube-transcript' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"url":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ","format":"text"}'
